notes.title: Horizon Shift '81 is available NOW on the Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
Hi All,

Horizon Shift '81 is now available for purchase on the Nintendo Switch eShop!

[u]Here's the trailer: [/u]
https://youtu.be/Z_FAM8zk-u0


[u]And here's a little bit about the game[/u]

Horizon Shift '81 is an explosive wave based, single screen, retro shooter. 
Do what it takes to protect your horizon from the ever encroaching enemy attack! 
Jump, Shoot, Dash and Flip your way through over 36 intense stages. 
Horizon Shift '81 is the sequel to the TIGA award nominated shooter, Horizon Shift.

There's more info on my [url=www.flumpstudios.co.uk]website [/url]

Thanks guys :)

notes.title: Horizon Shift '81 is only 4 days away!
notes.content:
The sequel to the 2015 TIGA award nominatied shooter, Horizon Shift launches on the 20th of December on the Nintendo Switch!

Horizon Shift ’81 is my love letter to all my favourite 80’s arcade games. A mishmash or remix of all the games I was obsessed with as a kid – Galaga, Asteroid, Tempest, Defender Missile Command to name a few. My goal was always to reproduce the excitement I remember feeling, playing those games in my local fish and chip shop, or on the rare occasions I was able to visit an actual Arcade.

Here's the offical trailer if you missed it
https://youtu.be/DaKhkTYu5UM


For more details check out the  Flump Studios website here http://www.flumpstudios.co.uk/

notes.title: Announcement trailer for my new game, Horizon Shift
notes.content:
Well, SKHR has been out for over a year now and it's been one hell of a learning experience! 
As much as I'm still proud of SKH I realise I made a LOT of mistakes.

Well, since the release of SKH I've been working on another shooter called Horizon Shift. Horizon Shift is a lot less traditional than SKH and I think it's a lot more interesting. 
It's a single screen shooter with some platform elements and a heavy risk reward system. Here's the official announcement trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ob9Hx0fGMBc

Horizon Shift won't have the same problems that plagued SKH.
It will have a proper HD resolution, leaderboards, steam achievements, Trading cards, re-mappable keys, smoother controls, full controller support, a proper fitting OST and best of all it doesn't require the damn windows media player to run :)

TL;TR .... Just watch the trailer :)

Thanks everyone for being awesome!

notes.title: V1.7 Now available with WASD controls and few fixes
notes.content:
Another update! Main change is the WASD and mouse controls as requested.
Also Tab rotation has been moved to F3 to fix the tab error.
On some PC's the game was running way to fast this has now been rectified.

New controls are as follows
W - Up
S - Down
A - Left
D - Right
U or Mouse 1 - Fire
I or Mouse 2 - Flamer
O or Space - Bomb
F1 - Full Screen
F2 - Screen Resolution
F3 - Screen Rotation

Of course the original control are all still intact :)

I hope this helps a few of you out, let me know if you have any issues.

Paul

notes.title: Super Killer Hornet V1.2 is now live
notes.content:
Fixed a couple of issues that have been mentioned.
Addressed the controller lag that some people have mentioned, this should no longer be an issues.
The screen size can now be changed on the fly using the num keys or right thumb stick.
Game now starts windowed, pressing F will toggle full screen mode.
Also fixed a couple of other minor gameplay.

Hope this update improves your experience :)

Paul

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Super Killer Hornet: Resurrection, 30% off!
notes.content:
Super Killer Hornet: Resurrection is Now Available on Steam and is 30% off*!
'Things will explode, things will die, you will dodge, you will do maths...Yes maths!'

Super Killer Hornet Resurrection is an intense vertical shooter with a brain train twist.

Through the chaos and explosion try to answer the falling math problems to increase your multiplier and power up your ship.

Featuring a superb sound track by UK rock hip hop maestros the Sixty fours as well as classic tracks from Dylan Barry.

*Offer ends February 13th at 10AM Pacific time.
